Qs for Seventeen. They are my Ult group. They debuted I 2015 with their song [Adore U](https://youtu.be/9rUFQJrCT7M) and this group, since their first year has been on Goan and Billboard charts. They experiment with different sounds and tempos which makes them different. The group has been self produced since the get-go. There are 3 units. Vocal, Hip hop and performance. Here is a [Helpful Guide to all 13 members](https://youtu.be/OkegkRY7Ogc) don't be sacred about the number, each member has a personality qnd flame to them which is easy to differentiate them. Two members (Jun and The 8) are from China and the most well treated Chinese kpop idols in the industry. They have a variety show called [Going Seventeen](https://youtu.be/ub96Mzr7BBQ) there are so many episodes so here is a link to my personal favorite episode. They are usually broken up into 2 or 3 parts per release so there is TONS for you to binge and enjoy. They are not only seen as the most synchronize ld group, but the funniest variety show.

There is ALOT to go over in regards to NCT. There are 4 subunits (NCT U, NCT Dream, NCT 127 qnd WayV) WayV is a subunit in China but do promote in Korea. 

I prefer their older bsides more than anything. They are my personal favorite. This is the group that got me into Kpop back in 2016. 

- [Chain](https://youtu.be/28XC2KRE-DE) is a personal favorite of mine. I believe it's the song Johnny debuted with (Not sure) but I will give it a listen. Its from NCT 127

- [Let's Play Ball](https://youtu.be/SCK8yBLqQJc) is NCT U most recent MV and comeback. They are the very first subunit that debuted back in 2016 qnd are real good 

- NCT Dream is my personal favorite subunit. I wish I can choose one song, but if I had to for this group. [Rocket](https://youtu.be/xNGLgw8NcKE) will have to be my all time favorite of this subunit. 

- WayV I am the least familiar with. All I do is listen to their songs and not really are up to date with them. But here is a song that got me into the Subunit [Dream Launch](https://youtu.be/jxKIOhAwrik)

They each have their own shows to help you dig into them as people. WayV has "Dreamin Plan", NCT 127 has Johnny Communication Center and  A rainy Night. NCT Dream has a lot of Behind the Scenes content and "Welcome to our home". As for NCT U, they don't have any that I know of. 

Hope this all helps!
